name: Asset Alchemist
title: The Living Cinema — Discovery, Sovereign Player & Poster Forge
subtitle: Streaming-style private collections, theater-ready playback and local cinematic movie artwork
features: Introduced streaming-style discovery shelves inside the original Video Vault: Continue Watching, Favorites, Recently Added and real personal collections.
Added instant title search, visually rich local video covers, progress bars, artwork-first movie detail dialogs and direct playback.
Movie details now allow local favorite toggling and collection edits, preserving all existing video bytes and watch history.
Introduced a premium Sovereign Theater playback bar with play/pause, 10-second jumps, precise scrub control, time readout, fullscreen, picture-in-picture and the existing Cinema Focus mode.

Added the Poster Forge: select a saved movie, load local PNG/JPG/GIF/WebP art or capture a frame from that same currently playing saved movie, refine crop/zoom/framing, add optional title and export 960×540 JPG.
Poster Forge writes only the existing movie poster metadata Blob after checking the title still exists. Original OPFS / IndexedDB video file bytes and local artwork databases are unchanged.
Connected the v3.8 homepage feature to the new discovery library with one-tap navigation and continued use of local artwork.
Added responsive iPhone/PC cinematic shelves, immersive details, touch-size theater controls and reduced-motion safeguards without autoplaying extra videos.
Retained all 18 studios, Video Vault imports, playback positions, animated personal covers, Home Screen icon studio, backups and cached v3.8 rollback.
